brief_summary: Side-by-side comparison of two three-by-three key grids drawn at the same scale (4.4 px per mm): MX spacing at 19.05 by 19.05 mm pitch on the left, Choc spacing at 18 by 17 mm pitch on the right. Dimension lines carry the pitch values; a dashed ghost line shows where the MX third row would end over the Choc grid, and a dusty-rose bracket marks the roughly 2 mm per-row vertical saving the article argues is a flat-plate travel reduction.
